title: Comparison remains left exact after transporting along the model equivalences.
statement: Let \(X\) be any scheme in universe \(u\) [def-pc-scheme], let \(v\) be any universe, and put \(w=\max(v,u+1)\). Write \(C=X_{\mathrm{\acute et}}\) and \(D=X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}\) for the small sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with topologies \(J,K\), and let \(i:C\to D\) be their inclusion [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For either underlying category \(B\), let \(B_w=\operatorname{AsSmall}^{w}(B)\): its objects and arrows are the universe lifts of those of \(B\), with unchanged identities and composition. Denote its inverse equivalences by \(a_B:B\to B_w\) and \(d_B:B_w\to B\), lifting and lowering objects and arrows. Equip \(C_w,D_w\) with the topologies induced along \(d_C,d_D\): a sieve covers precisely when its image generates a covering sieve on the original site. Set \(i_w=a_D\circ i\circ d_C\). On sheaves valued in \(\mathrm{Type}_w\), define \(L_wF=(\operatorname{Lan}_{i_w^{\mathrm{op}}}F)^\#\), using sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Then \(L_w:\operatorname{Sh}(C_w,\mathrm{Type}_w)\to\operatorname{Sh}(D_w,\mathrm{Type}_w)\) preserves finite limits [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits]. This is the functor \(\texttt{AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.smallModelComparisonPullback}^{u,v}(X)\), with no restrictions on \(X\) or on the relation between \(u\) and \(v\).

proof.text: The inverse of the etale AsSmall equivalence and the functor of the pro-etale AsSmall equivalence are right adjoints, hence representably flat. The original toProEt inclusion is representably flat by AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.representablyFlat_toProEt. Mathlib RepresentablyFlat.comp therefore proves representable flatness of smallModelComparisonInclusion. Continuity is supplied by the first theorem of this module.

Both transported site categories are small in max v (u + 1), the universe of the coefficient Type category. Mathlib lan_preservesFiniteLimits_of_flat thus proves finite-limit preservation of the presheaf left Kan extension. Apply Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.instPreservesFiniteLimitsSheafSheafPullback: sheaf inclusion, this Kan extension, and sheafification preserve finite limits. The displayed smallModelComparisonPullback is exactly this constructed functor, so no comparison natural isomorphism or transport of the original-site adjunction is needed.
